name: loop-breaker
description: Stops Claude repeating the same failing tool call. Counts identical calls that error or are refused, hints after the second, refuses the next after the threshold with a reason Claude can act on, and shows a worsening face above the prompt with a one-key Stop and rethink.

threshold.title: Identical failures before refusing
threshold.description: How many times the exact same tool call may fail in a row before loop-breaker refuses the next identical attempt. Default 3.

allow.title: Tools never refused
allow.description: Comma-separated tool names loop-breaker leaves alone, for example "Bash,Read". Empty means every tool is watched.

retryLater.title: Failures that mean try again later
retryLater.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against the first 400 characters of a failed call's text. A match is not counted as a failed attempt: an admission guard deferring a job, a rate limit, a dropped connection. Empty counts every failure. For a command that polls on purpose, allowlist its tool or add its own wording here.
retryLater.default: deferred|try again later|retry after|rate limit|too many requests|\b429\b|\b503\b|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|EAGAIN|temporarily unavailable|already running
